description: K2 create: `not` is unsupported by @effect/openapi-generator (`Cannot import JSON Schema keyword "not"`); the resource props re-express the exclusion as a type.
K2 update: same unsupported `not` constraint as create; re-expressed as a type in the resource props.
Telemetry query filters: an allOf over two unions cannot be intersected without expanding branches; the alternatives are re-expressed as a type in the resource props.
Pipelines SourceField: an allOf over the FieldType oneOf cannot be intersected with an object without expanding branches; the field descriptor is re-expressed as a type in the resource props.

Containers cc_InstanceType: the generator attaches the schema-level default to each anyOf literal, producing `Schema.Literal("basic").annotate({ default: "lite" })`, which fails strict typecheck; dropped so the enum typechecks.

Worker placement: a oneOf nested directly inside allOf cannot be intersected with the schema's other allOf members without expanding every alternative; it is replaced by a reference to `workers_placement_info_no_status`, whose alternatives are identical.

Worker placement: this member re-adds the read-only `last_analyzed_at` / `status` fields over the placement union, which the generator cannot intersect without expanding every alternative; the read-only status pair is left unmodelled on the response schema.

Script settings placement: the generator attaches the schema-level `default: {}` to each alternative of the placement union, producing `Schema.Struct({ mode: ... }).annotate({ default: {} })`, which fails strict typecheck; dropped so the union typechecks.

Script settings: `bindings` intersects `workers_bindings` (an array of the binding oneOf) with a second array of the same union, which the generator cannot intersect without expanding every binding alternative; the redundant shell is dropped, leaving the published `workers_bindings` array.

Worker upload: this duplicate shell only re-adds metadata.annotations, which would intersect an object into the string metadata declared above (and cannot be intersected); metadata.annotations is re-expressed as a type in the emulator's metadata schema.
Notification policies: the API accepts `workers_observability_alert` but the published schema omits it (terraform-provider-cloudflare #7259); added so the Issues chain's policy typechecks.

value.description: A `metadata` JSON text part plus one file part per module, each named by its filename.

description: Worker upload: Cloudflare's multipart upload metadata docs name each module part by its filename (the name `main_module` references), which is what Alchemy's client sends, while the schema declares only a `files` part. Effect refuses an index signature beside declared properties, so the body is modelled as its wire shape: a record of text parts and file parts. The metadata part is JSON text the generator cannot decode from multipart, so the emulator decodes it with its own metadata schema.
